convertibility_reason: Time-based open/close EA with no indicators, fixed lot sizing, simple entry/exit rules. Uses only standard MQL5 Trade library classes (CTrade, CSymbolInfo, CAccountInfo, CTerminalInfo) and ArrayLong.mqh - no custom indicators or complex logic. The core logic is purely time-triggered position management.

params.adjustment: SL clamped to broker StopLevel using max(StopLevel, InputSL)*Point; StopLevel = StopsLevel or Spread*InpSizeSpread
TP clamped to broker StopLevel using max(StopLevel, InputTP)*Point; StopLevel = StopsLevel or Spread*InpSizeSpread

other_exits: Time-based close: when current bar time crosses close_time threshold, all positions of the configured type are closed
Opposite side close: when opening BUY and SELL positions exist, they are closed first; when opening SELL and BUY positions exist, they are closed first

params.lot_correction: CorrectLots rounds down to nearest valid lot step, clamps to min/max, and checks symbol LotsLimit against accumulated volume

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Lot is adjusted via trade.CheckVolume() for symbol constraints and CheckLotForLimitAccount() for total volume limit per symbol side. Volume is rounded down to nearest valid step.

custom_logic_notes: This is a time-based EA that opens a position at a specified time (hour:minute) and closes it at another specified time. Entry trigger: when current time (hour*60+minute) >= open_time AND bar[0] time was <= open_time (i.e. the open_time was crossed between bar[0] open and current tick). Similarly for close. The position type (BUY or SELL) is a static input - not signal-driven. If opening BUY and SELL positions exist, SELL is closed first (and vice versa). Requires hedge account (netting accounts rejected in OnInit). SL/TP in points (not pips) - adjusted by broker StopLevel: SL/TP is set to max(broker_stop_level, input_value)*Point. The size_spread multiplier is used to calculate an artificial stop level when broker StopsLevel is 0 (spread*size_spread).
python_conversion_notes: Simple time-based EA. No indicators needed. Key logic: (1) Track bar-open time vs current tick time to detect crossing of open_time/close_time thresholds. (2) Open fixed-lot BUY or SELL at open_time, close at close_time. (3) Close opposite side before opening. (4) SL/TP adjusted for broker stop level. (5) Requires hedge-mode account semantics. No indicator data needed - only time and price. M1 bars sufficient for backtesting since the trigger is time-based with new-bar guard.
